## Services, pricing and processing times

Pricing is USD, kickoff fee + success fee. The kickoff fee covers preparation and filing of the application. The success fee is due only after successful processing — no success, no success fee. Government/embassy fees are separate and non-refundable.

### 1. Tourist Visa (https://visaindiaexpert.com/visa/tourist)
- Price: $199 kickoff + $100 success fee
- Typical validity: 30–120 days
- Processing time: 3–7 business days
- Max stay: 90 days per entry
- Use cases: holidays, family visits, short stays (30-day to 5-year multiple entry options)

### 2. Business Visa (https://visaindiaexpert.com/visa/business)
- Price: $349 kickoff + $150 success fee
- Typical validity: 1–5 years (multiple entry)
- Processing time: 1–3 weeks
- Max stay: 180 days per visit
- Use cases: meetings, conferences, investment trips, site visits

### 3. Medical Visa (https://visaindiaexpert.com/visa/medical)
- Price: $199 kickoff + $100 success fee
- Typical validity: matched to treatment
- Processing time: 3–10 business days
- Attendants allowed: up to 2 per patient
- Use cases: treatment in India, second opinions, long-term care (plus attendant visas)

### 4. E-1 Business Visa (https://visaindiaexpert.com/visa/e-1)
- Price: $499 kickoff + $200 success fee
- Typical validity: 1–5 years
- Processing time: 2–6 months (varies greatly)
- FRRO registration: required on arrival in India
- Use cases: founders and directors establishing or expanding a business in India; includes MCA documents, apostilled board resolutions, FRRO registration

### 5. B-1 Employment Visa (https://visaindiaexpert.com/visa/b-1)
- Price: $499 kickoff + $200 success fee
- Typical validity: up to 5 years / contract length
- Processing time: 4–12 weeks
- FRRO registration: required on arrival in India
- Use cases: foreign workers taking employment in India; contract, employer letter and salary documentation

### 6. Spouse / Dependent Visa (https://visaindiaexpert.com/visa/spouse)
- Price: $349 kickoff + $150 success fee
- Typical validity: matched to main visa
- Processing time: 3–8 weeks (parallel track)
- Max dependents: spouse + children
- Use cases: spouse and dependent children of visa holders; apostilled marriage certificates, parallel processing

### 7. Student Visa (https://visaindiaexpert.com/visa/student)
- Price: $349 kickoff + $150 success fee
- Typical validity: course duration
- Processing time: 2–6 weeks
- Key requirement: university admission letter
- Use cases: study in India; admission letters, proof of funds, statement of purpose

### 8. Other Visa Type — Free Case Review (https://visaindiaexpert.com/visa/other)
- Price: $199 kickoff + $100 success fee
- First step: free 15-minute case review
- Processing time: case by case
- Use cases: re-applicants, complex visa histories, unclear category; outcome is a clear visa category and plan

## How the process works

1. Case intake: WhatsApp-first contact; the case is reviewed and the correct visa category is confirmed.
2. Kickoff fee: paid by Wise bank transfer; work starts (document checklist, application preparation).
3. Preparation: the dedicated consultant prepares and reviews the full application file (forms, documents, translations, apostilles where needed).
4. Filing: application is submitted to the appropriate Indian mission / online portal.
5. Tracking: status is tracked and the client is kept informed until a decision.
6. Success: on approval, the success fee is due; on rejection, no success fee is charged.
7. Post-approval: FRRO registration guidance where required (E-1, B-1, employment categories).

## Payments

- Currency: USD
- Method: Wise bank transfer (no card payments; no card data is collected or stored)
- Wise account: IBAN BE73905633425060, SWIFT TRWIBEB1XXX, account name "ENERGY STOCK ALLIANCE Limited -THE-" (Wise, Brussels)
- Invoices: generated on the website with a unique invoice number; payment status is tracked per invoice.

## Refund policy (summary — full policy at https://visaindiaexpert.com/refund)

- Kickoff fee refundable in full within 48 hours if no work has started.
- Once preparation work has started, the kickoff fee is non-refundable.
- Success fee is charged only after successful processing; never charged on rejection.
- Government/embassy fees are non-refundable (paid to authorities directly or on their behalf).
- Refunds are issued via Wise within 5 business days.

## Common questions

- "Can you guarantee a visa?" No. Approvals are decided solely by Indian missions; the service prepares and manages the application to maximize the chance of approval.
- "What happens if my visa is rejected?" No success fee is charged. The consultant reviews the rejection and can advise on re-application strategy.
- "How do I pay?" Wise bank transfer in USD against an invoice generated on the website.
- "How fast is a tourist visa?" Typically 3–7 business days for processing, subject to the mission.
- "Do you handle FRRO registration?" Yes, for categories that require it (E-1, B-1/employment), registration guidance and filing are part of the service.
